extDesc.message: Send downloads to the Aria2 Desktop download manager

secretHint.message: Pairing fills this automatically, or copy it under Settings → RPC Security in the app

quickSendPlaceholder.message: Paste a download or magnet link

newDownloadDesc.message: Paste an HTTP, HTTPS, or magnet link.

newDownloadHint.message: HTTP, HTTPS and magnet links supported

saveToDefault.message: Determined by the app's download folder and category rules

userAgentPlaceholder.message: Uses the browser UA by default

refererPlaceholder.message: Uses the current page by default

invalidDownloadUrl.message: Enter a valid HTTP, HTTPS, or magnet link

invalidReferer.message: Referer must be a complete http(s) URL

connectedButDisabled.message: Connected, but the extension is disabled

invalidPort.message: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535

permissionDenied.message: Permission to access $1 was not granted

errCannotConnect.message: Cannot connect to $1 — make sure the app and engine are running

errUnauthorized.message: Wrong secret — copy it under Settings → RPC Security in the app

errTimeout.message: Connection timed out — check host and port

errEngineUnavailable.message: Engine not running — start it in the app first

errApiInvalidUrl.message: Only http / https / ftp / sftp / magnet links are supported

errUnknown.message: Something went wrong, please try again

downloadSentToSubdir.message: Added to Aria2 Desktop (saved to the $SUBDIR$ folder)

downloadSentRenamed.message: Added to Aria2 Desktop (existing file kept, saved as $NAME$)

interceptedToSubdir.message: Handed over to Aria2 Desktop (saved to the $SUBDIR$ folder)

interceptedRenamed.message: Handed over to Aria2 Desktop (existing file kept, saved as $NAME$)

rightClickHint.message: You can also right-click a link, video or audio to send it directly

pairHint.message: Click, then press Allow in the app — the secret fills automatically

pairingWaiting.message: Press Allow in the App dialog

pairingForbidden.message: Pairing rejected — update the app or enter the secret manually

pairingSecretRequired.message: Set an RPC secret in Settings → RPC & Security first, then pair

pairingUnreachable.message: App not detected (not running or too old)

pairingFailed.message: Pairing failed — enter the secret manually

unpairConfirm.message:
Unpair?
This clears the saved access secret and connection settings. You can pair again anytime.

unpairDone.message: Unpaired — connection settings restored to defaults

unpairDoneRevoked.message: Unpaired — local settings cleared and the app-side grant revoked

unpairServerPending.message: Unpaired locally, but the app did not respond — the app-side grant may still exist

unpairHint.message: Unpairing also revokes this extension's grant in the app

pasteFailed.message: Cannot read clipboard, please paste manually

sendNeedPairing.message: Pair first to start sending downloads

pairingInBackground.message: Pairing: switch to the app and click Allow. This window can be closed.

interceptAllDesc.message: Browser downloads go to the app automatically (original cancelled)

allowCookiesDesc.message: Avoids 403 on login-only sites (needs site permission)

cookiesEnabled.message: Enabled: page cookies will be sent

cookiesDisabled.message: Disabled: page cookies are no longer sent

cookiesPermissionDenied.message: Site access not granted — cannot read cookies

mediaNone.message: No directly downloadable video on this page

mediaBlobHint.message: Assembled at runtime — use “Download this page” above

mediaStreamHint.message: Segmented stream (m3u8/mpd) — use App download above

mediaUnsupportedPage.message: Only regular web pages can be scanned

streamPageSent.message: Sent to the App — check its download list

streamPageFallback.message: App unavailable — direct links are listed below

streamPageNeedPair.message: Pair with the app first (Pairing & Settings)

streamPageYtdlpMissing.message: yt-dlp missing in the app — install it on the Stream tab

streamPageFfmpegMissing.message: ffmpeg missing in the app — cannot merge audio

streamPageUnreachable.message: App not detected (not running or too old)

streamPageUnsupported.message: This page is not a downloadable web page

pairingDoneDesc.message: Extension connected to Aria2 Desktop — you can send downloads now

grabFailed.message: Grab failed: page restricted or permission needed

taskStreamNotRunning.message: This task is no longer downloading

snifferHint.message: Shows network requests from the current tab only.

snifferPermissionNeeded.message: Site access is required to observe requests from the current page.

snifferPermissionDenied.message: Site access was not granted; network sniffing is unavailable.

snifferEmpty.message: No requests captured from this page yet

pageVideoDesc.message: Uses the app's yt-dlp; merges DASH audio/video (e.g. Bilibili)

snifferBilibiliHint.message: Streaming segments (DASH/MSE) detected — use “Smart video resolver” above to download the complete video.

snifferFragmentHint.message: A stream segment cannot be downloaded alone; use Smart video resolver.

enableExtDesc.message: Turns off the context menu and download interception

settingsHint.message: The extension does not store downloads; tasks and files stay in Aria2 Desktop.

manualHint.message: Use this only when the app cannot be discovered automatically.

errInsufficientScope.message: This extension lacks the required permission. Please pair again.

errAppUnavailable.message: Cannot reach Aria2 Desktop. Make sure the app is running.

interceptFallbackDesc.message: Aria2 could not take over this download, so the browser restarted it with the original file name and referrer.

interceptManualRetry.message: Neither Aria2 nor the browser could finish this download. Please retry manually: $URL$

snifferPlaylistHint.message: Playlists are handed to the app's streaming mode and are not downloaded as a single file

snifferPlaylistEmpty.message: No playlist detected on this page

playlistStreamDesc.message: Resolve m3u8/mpd manifests and merge segments into one video
